title: A fresh coat of paint
body: Animated backgrounds on the login and replay pages, plus subtle 3D tilt and glow on the sidebar league gems. Effects scale back automatically on lower-powered devices.

title: Season 11 is here
body: The tier list and draft costs have been rebuilt on the new National Dex+ scaling, and the rules page is synced to match. Jet Punch is now unbanned on Palafin.

title: Matchup Center is now public
body: Scout matchups without signing in. Playing on Showdown still requires a login.

title: Edit tera captains any time
body: Change your tera captains and their tera types at any point during the season, not just before it starts.

title: Upload your own team logo
body: Team owners can now upload a custom logo straight from their team page.

title: Smoother updates
body: The site now recovers gracefully right after an update instead of showing a stale-page error, with new behind-the-scenes error tracking so issues get caught faster.
